# Solution Design Workshop

<!-- BREADRUMB PLACEHOLDER -->

---

> Collaborative approach to designing technical solutions that align with business requirements and enterprise architecture standards.

---
page_texts.3:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/solution-design.md#purpose]

### Purpose

Facilitate collaborative solution design that brings together business stakeholders, architects, and technical teams to create comprehensive, implementable solutions.
page_texts.4:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/solution-design.md#objectives]

### Objectives

- Translate business requirements into technical solution designs
- Ensure alignment with enterprise architecture standards and patterns
- Generate consensus on solution approach and technical decisions
- Create detailed implementation roadmap with clear deliverables
- Identify and mitigate solution risks and dependencies
page_texts.5:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/solution-design.md#success-criteria]

### Success Criteria

- **Solution Completeness**: All key architectural components defined
- **Stakeholder Alignment**: 85%+ agreement on solution approach
- **Architecture Compliance**: Solution adheres to EA standards and patterns
- **Implementation Readiness**: Clear roadmap with defined deliverables and timelines

---
page_texts.7:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/solution-design.md#3-weeks-before-workshop]

### 3 Weeks Before Workshop

**Business Requirements Analysis:**

- [ ] Gather and analyze business requirements documentation
- [ ] Conduct stakeholder interviews to understand needs and constraints
- [ ] Identify success criteria and acceptance criteria
- [ ] Document current state processes and systems

**Technical Context Assessment:**

- [ ] Review enterprise architecture standards and patterns
- [ ] Assess current technical landscape and constraints
- [ ] Identify integration points and dependencies
- [ ] Gather non-functional requirements (performance, security, scalability)
page_texts.8:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/solution-design.md#2-weeks-before-workshop]

### 2 Weeks Before Workshop

**Preparation Activities:**

- [ ] Create initial solution concepts and options
- [ ] Prepare technical reference materials and standards
- [ ] Set up collaborative design tools and shared workspaces
- [ ] Coordinate with subject matter experts and stakeholders

**Participant Preparation:**

- [ ] Distribute pre-read materials including requirements and context
- [ ] Confirm participant roles and decision-making authority
- [ ] Schedule any required preliminary discussions
- [ ] Prepare design templates and workshop materials
page_texts.9:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/solution-design.md#1-week-before-workshop]

### 1 Week Before Workshop

**Final Setup:**

- [ ] Confirm logistics and technology setup
- [ ] Prepare design tools and templates
- [ ] Brief facilitators and subject matter experts
- [ ] Validate participant availability and commitment

[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/solution-design.md#technical-requirements-template]

### Technical Requirements Template

```markdown
## Functional Requirements

- [Requirement 1]: [Description and acceptance criteria]
- [Requirement 2]: [Description and acceptance criteria]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- Performance: [Response time, throughput, capacity targets]
- Security: [Authentication, authorization, data protection]
- Scalability: [Growth expectations and scaling approach]
- Availability: [Uptime requirements and disaster recovery]
- Maintainability: [Support and maintenance considerations]

## Integration Requirements

- [System 1]: [Integration type, data exchange, protocols]
- [System 2]: [Integration type, data exchange, protocols]

## Constraints

- Technical: [Technology limitations, standards compliance]
- Business: [Budget, timeline, resource constraints]
- Regulatory: [Compliance requirements, industry standards]
```

page_texts.28:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/solution-design.md#key-facilitation-techniques]

### Key Facilitation Techniques

**Collaborative Design**

- Use visual design tools and shared workspaces
- Encourage parallel design and convergence
- Balance technical depth with business understanding
- Maintain focus on solution viability

**Decision Making**

- Use structured decision-making frameworks
- Ensure technical decisions align with business needs
- Document decision rationale and trade-offs
- Build consensus through iterative refinement

**Managing Complexity**

- Break complex problems into manageable components
- Use layered design approach (conceptual to detailed)
- Focus on critical path and high-risk areas first
- Maintain big picture perspective throughout
page_texts.29:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/solution-design.md#common-challenges-and-solutions]

### Common Challenges and Solutions

**Scope Creep**

- **Challenge**: Requirements expanding during design
- **Solution**: Clear scope boundaries, change control process

**Technical Disagreements**

- **Challenge**: Multiple valid technical approaches
- **Solution**: Criteria-based evaluation, prototype validation

**Business-Technical Disconnect**

- **Challenge**: Business and technical teams not aligned
- **Solution**: Regular translation between business and technical language

**Analysis Paralysis**

- **Challenge**: Over-analyzing without making decisions
- **Solution**: Time-boxed activities, "good enough" decision threshold

### Immediate Deliverables (Within 48 Hours)

- **Solution Design Summary**: High-level architecture and approach
- **Technical Requirements Document**: Detailed functional and non-functional requirements
- **Risk and Dependency Register**: Identified risks with mitigation strategies
- **Action Item Tracker**: Next steps with owners and timelines
page_texts.32:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/solution-design.md#follow-up-deliverables-within-1-week]

### Follow-up Deliverables (Within 1 Week)

- **Detailed Solution Architecture**: Comprehensive design documentation
- **Implementation Plan**: Phased delivery approach with timelines and resources
- **Technology Standards Compliance**: Alignment with EA standards and patterns
- **Project Charter**: Formal project initiation documentation
page_texts.33:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/solution-design.md#long-term-tracking-ongoing]

### Long-term Tracking (Ongoing)

- **Design Review Checkpoints**: Regular architecture review sessions
- **Implementation Progress**: Development milestone tracking
- **Quality Assurance**: Testing and validation results
- **Solution Performance**: Post-implementation performance metrics

---
page_texts.35:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/solution-design.md#workshop-effectiveness]

### Workshop Effectiveness

- **Design Completeness**: All architectural components defined and documented
- **Stakeholder Satisfaction**: Average rating 4.5/5.0 on workshop value
- **Decision Quality**: Technical decisions supported by clear rationale
- **Implementation Readiness**: Clear path from design to development
page_texts.36:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/solution-design.md#solution-quality-metrics]

### Solution Quality Metrics

- **Architecture Compliance**: 100% alignment with EA standards and patterns
- **Requirements Traceability**: All requirements mapped to solution components
- **Risk Mitigation**: All high/critical risks have mitigation strategies
- **Stakeholder Approval**: Formal sign-off from business and technical stakeholders
page_texts.37:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/solution-design.md#implementation-success-indicators]

### Implementation Success Indicators

- **On-Time Delivery**: Implementation milestones met per agreed timeline
- **Budget Adherence**: Development costs within approved budget parameters
- **Quality Achievement**: Solution meets defined acceptance criteria
- **Business Value**: Measurable benefits realized post-implementation

---
page_texts.39:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/solution-design.md#rapid-solution-design-1-day]

### Rapid Solution Design (1 Day)

- Pre-defined requirements and constraints
- Focus on high-level architecture only
- Limited technology options evaluation
- Suitable for well-understood problem domains
page_texts.40:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/solution-design.md#enterprise-solution-design-3-days]

### Enterprise Solution Design (3 Days)

- Complex, multi-system integration scenarios
- Extensive stakeholder involvement
- Detailed technical specification development
- Comprehensive risk and dependency analysis
page_texts.41:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/solution-design.md#agile-solution-design-half-day]

### Agile Solution Design (Half Day)

- Sprint-level solution design
- Focus on specific user stories or features
- Rapid prototyping and validation
- Iterative design refinement
page_texts.42:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/solution-design.md#legacy-modernization-design-2-days]

### Legacy Modernization Design (2 Days)

- Current state analysis and gap assessment
- Migration strategy and approach definition
- Risk assessment for legacy system changes
- Transition planning and execution roadmap
